pages.text: Functionalist understanding: Hype Studies as a Sociology of Expectations 2.0? Expectations are functional for innovation systems: • They are performative: stabilize orientation, attract interest, provide legitimation, foster investment. • They coordinate actors across levels and contexts by linking present decisions to imagined futures. • They turn promises into present obligations (“promise-requirement cycle”). • They have a temporal pattern (“hype cycle”). • They relate imagination & materiality. Functional analysis examines what “problem” a phenomenon (expectations) solves for a system – how it organizes, stabilizes, or reproduces social order in different cases.
